description: Email the quiz to recipients — each gets a unique tracked link so responses tie back to them (see get_sends). Any account with a confirmed email address; capped per month and per 24 hours (Free: 200/mo, 50/day; Plus: 5,000/mo). Confirm the recipient list with your user before calling: this sends real email immediately.

message.description: Optional short note from the sender, shown above the button.

quiz_id.description: Quiz id (the `id` field returned by create_quiz/list_quizzes).

name.description: Optional name, used in the greeting.

name: send_quiz_by_email
title: Send Quiz By Email
